name: Inox Wind Ltd
title: Inox Wind Ltd - 539083 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Inox Wind Q4 FY26 revenue flat at INR1,306 crore with FY26 top line INR4,600 crore vs INR5,000 crore guidance; FY27 guided up ~75%, but working-capital slippage and PSU receivable delays persist.

triggers.label: Receivables slow; PSU payment delays
triggers.quote: On the receivable front, there has been some challenges, especially in our PSU contracts, where we have seen payment delays.

triggers.label: FY26 revenue INR4,600 cr vs INR5,000 cr guide
triggers.quote: as against the guideline of INR5,000 crores, which we have given in the last call, we have achieved INR4,600 crores

triggers.label: Shift to equipment supply: 75-80% of order book
triggers.quote: we have now pivoted towards almost 75% to 80% of our order book now being equipment supply.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth ~75%, EBITDA margin ~20%
triggers.quote: we expect our consolidated revenue to grow by around 75% over FY26 with EBITDA margin to be 20% to 20%.

guidance.quote: we expect our consolidated revenue to grow by around 75% over FY26
with EBITDA margin to be 20% to 20%
we maintain our FY27 EBITDA guidance to be upwards of INR600 crores

prior_guidance_check.quote: as against the guideline of INR5,000 crores, which we have given in the last call, we have achieved INR4,600 crores
we were quite confident of achieving net working capital days of about 200 days

red_flags.label: FY26 revenue miss vs guidance
red_flags.quote: we have achieved INR4,600 crores and this INR400 crores of makeover will happen in the qu arter 1, quarter 2 time scale.

red_flags.label: Related-party order dependence (Inox Clean)
red_flags.quote: we expect to receive large recurring order inflows from our Group Company, Inox Clean Energy, over the next few years.

red_flags.label: Other income ~INR40 cr from acquisition debt inflates Green EBITDA
red_flags.quote: majority of the other income which you are seeing in our P&L statement related to the two strategic, related to the debt which we have acquired

evasions.quote: That is the number that we have refrained from giving.

evasions.topic: Standalone cash/dividend policy for Inox Green
evasions.quote: Let the consolidation of the two companies happen. Once that happens, I'm sure the Board in all its wisdom will put in place a dividend policy.
